method_input.plan_text:
Entities:
- E1 (team): solo_commit = true; committed = true.
- E2 (team): committed = true.
- E3: ready = true; status = "FULL".
- office wifi: name = "office wifi".
Links:
- E1 → E2 (supports).
- E2 → E1 (informs).
- E2 → E3 (supports).
Link kinds: 'requires', 'supports', 'causes', 'blocks', 'enables' and 'derived_from' carry influence from the first entity to the second; 'informs' and 'references' do not carry influence. An 'influencing link into X' means one of the first kind ending at X.
Rules:
- committed of E1 = [committed of E2, counted only while E2 has an influencing link into E1; otherwise solo_commit of E1].
- committed of E2 = [committed of E1, counted only while E1 has an influencing link into E2; otherwise false].
- ready of E3 = [committed of E2, counted only while E2 has an influencing link into E3; otherwise false].
- status of E3 is "FULL" if (ready of E3); otherwise "INVALID".
- committed of E1 can only be one of [true, false].
- committed of E2 can only be one of [true, false].
